facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the IT necessary for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
The Goethe University hotline helps with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subjects, double study programs, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The student secretariat assists with questions related to applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subjects, double study programs, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
The Central Student Advising offers help regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subjects, double study programs, leave of absence, and exmatriculation.
International Student Services provide information on residence permits, German courses, funding, studying successfully, careers, and more. They also offer advice and support.

The Student Union supports students in social and economic matters and provides infrastructure necessary for successful studying, including advising and assistance in educational funding and student housing.
